title: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.12934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve

translated_title: EarthRecord：利用多模态智能体从四十年卫星影像的像素解析土地变化
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态智能体现在能够借助工具执行复杂的数据分析，但它们将数十年的卫星影像转化为可靠的土地变化分析的能力——这对地球观测科学至关重要——仍未被衡量。现有基准存在不足：它们在精选影像上提出问题，或为智能体提供预处理的输入，遗漏了此类分析起步所需的原始多传感器档案。我们提出EarthRecord，一个基于56个站点原始记录构建的基准：涵盖四十年的Landsat、MODIS、VIIRS和Sentinel-2数据，云掩膜和跨传感器协调工作留给智能体自行完成。该基准提出238个横跨十项分析任务的土地变化问题，依据保留的全球产品参考、方法间一致性以及视觉解译进行评分。两组对照实验用于检验答案的依据：闭卷实验移除数据记录，仪器对实验则改变一颗卫星的数据而地面实际并无变化。对十二个
tldr: 提出EarthRecord基准，基于56个站点四十年的原始多传感器卫星影像，要求多模态智能体自主完成云掩膜和跨传感器协调，通过238个土地变化问题及对照实验评估其真实土地变化分析能力。
en_tdlr: EarthRecord is a benchmark that challenges multimodal agents to perform reliable land-change analysis from four decades of raw multi-sensor satellite imagery across 56 sites, requiring autonomous cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization, evaluated via 238 questions across ten tasks with controlled experiments.
